# amesh_flow (Data Source)

Read A versioned AMESH flow document.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "amesh_flow" "hello" {
  key       = "hello"
  namespace = "examples"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Caller-owned key, name or path.

### Optional

- `namespace` (String) Required AMESH namespace (or tenant slug for worker-group policy resources).
- `server_id` (String) Server-generated identifier for generated-ID resources.

### Read-Only

- `etag` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `remote_digest` (String) SHA-256 of the redacted remote representation.
- `remote_document` (String, Sensitive) Canonical redacted remote representation.
- `revision` (String)
